about_the_game:
Experience the grandeur and danger of the ancient world, where gods shape the fate of mortals. During the celebrations honoring Poseidon, three heroes—Pelias, Jason, and Medea—become unwitting victims of divine wrath. Lead them through a series of mysterious islands, each ruled by a monster or a curse. Immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of Ancient Greece, where heroes and gods wage an endless battle for the fate of the world!

Game Features:

  • A unique hero—Poseidon, the mighty ruler of the seas!

  • Unpredictable story twists await at every turn!

  • Epic and vibrant comics with a gripping narrative!

  • New, diverse, and breathtaking locations shaped by the will of the Sea Lord!

  • Exciting and varied ways to complete each level!

  • Accessible tutorials to quickly master the basics of the game!

  • Each set of locations introduces new gameplay mechanics!

  • Increased dynamics and engagement with two workers appearing almost at the start of the game!

  • 50 levels of captivating and relaxing gameplay!
